attempts.text:
The plan rescues 8 people, defers 12, and has a total cost of 716.

- **Evacuation point:** Myagang shelter is the only one. Nilkantha temple isn't designated, so nobody can be dropped there.
- **Road access:** Myagang connects to the flood area only through Nilkantha temple and Naukunda village. Thakre village has no one waiting and leads nowhere else.
- **Closed roads:** Galchhi–Shivapuri and Dhunche–Shivapuri are closed, and Galchhi–Bidur is flooded. Bidur and Shivapuri can only be reached through Naukunda and Dhunche.

| Location | People | Round trip from Myagang (minutes) | Deferral penalty | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Galchhi village | 3 children, 1 injured | 214 | 260 | Rescue all 4 with one full car, saving 46 overall |
| Nilkantha temple | 7 adults | 62 per trip | 140 | Make one trip for 4 adults (penalty saved 80) and defer the other 3 |
| Bidur school | 3 children | 238 | 180 | Defer, as the trip costs 58 more than the penalty |
| Shivapuri care home | 4 elderly | 278 | 200 | Defer, as the trip costs 78 more than the penalty |

**Alternatives that cost more:**
- **Second Nilkantha trip:** this costs 62 to avoid 60 in penalties, for a total of 718.
- **Adding a Bidur trip:** even with 1 Nilkantha adult picked up on the way back, the total is 754.
- **Adding a Shivapuri trip carrying the 3 Bidur children and 1 elderly person:** the total is 764.
- **Deferring everyone:** the total is 780.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village galchhi-village
load car1 injured 1
load car1 child 3
drive car1 galchhi-village naukunda-village
drive car1 naukunda-village nilkantha-temple
drive car1 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 child 3
drive car2 myagang-shelter nilkantha-temple
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 nilkantha-temple myagang-shelter
unload car2 adult 4
defer nilkantha-temple adult 3
defer bidur-school child 3
defer shivapuri-care-home elderly 4
</plan>

**Cost breakdown:**
- **Driving:** 214 (car1) + 62 (car2) = 276
- **Penalties:** 3 adults (60) + 3 children (180) + 4 elderly (200) = 440
- **Total:** 276 + 440 = 716

COST: 716
